description_en: Queries the details of a stream draft job
description_zh: 查询工作流草稿作业详细信息
name: GetJob

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query task details
parameters.name: verbose

Arguments.description_en: The arguments of the PAIFlow pipeline run
Arguments.example:
---
arguments:
  parameters:
  - name: "execution_maxcompute"
    value:
      endpoint: "http://service.cn-shanghai.maxcompute.aliyun.com/api"
      odpsProject: "xxxxxxx"

Creator.description_en: The user ID of the creator

ExecuteType.description_en:
The execution type. Valid values:
EXECUTE_ALL: runs all nodes in the stream draft.
EXECUTE_ONE: runs a specified node.
EXECUTE_TO_HERE: runs from the root node to the specified node.
EXECUTE_FROM_HERE: runs from the specified node.
EXECUTE_CHILDREN: runs the downstream nodes of the specified node
ExecuteType.description_zh:
执行的类型:
EXECUTE_ALL(运行工作流草稿中所有节点)
EXECUTE_ONE(执行指定节点)
EXECUTE_TO_HERE(从根节点执行到该节点)
EXECUTE_FROM_HERE(从指定的节点开始运行)
EXECUTE_CHILDREN(执行指定节点的下游节点)

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

NodeId.description_en: The node ID in the stream draft

PaiflowNodeId.description_en: The pipeline run node ID in PAIFlow

RunId.description_en: The pipeline run ID in PAIFlow

RunInfo.description_en: The manifests of the pipeline run that corresponds to the job
RunInfo.example:
apiVersion: "core/v1"
metadata:
  version: "v1"
  identifier: "1de8f7c8-a9d8-4433-9e87-d95979ccab14"
  annotations: {}
spec:
  inputs:
    artifacts: []
    parameters:
    - name: "execution"
      type: "Map"
  arguments:
    artifacts: []
    parameters: []
  dependencies: []
  initContainers: []
  sideCarContainers: []
  pipelines:
  - apiVersion: "core/v1"
    metadata:
      provider: "pai"
      name: "id-2d88-1608982098027-91558"
      version: "v1"
      identifier: "type_transform"
      annotations: {}

Status.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:
Initialized: The job is initialized.
Starting: The job is starting.
WorkflowServiceStarting: The job is being prepared for submission.
Running: The job is running.
Succeeded: The job succeeded.
Failed: The job failed.
Terminating: The job is being terminated.
Terminated: The job is terminated.
Unknown: The job status is unknown.
Skipped: The job is skipped because a predecessor node failed.
ReadyToSchedule: The job is ready to run because a predecessor node has not completed
Status.description_zh:
作业状态。取值：
Initialized: 初始化完成
Starting：开始
WorkflowServiceStarting：准备提交
Running：运行中
Succeeded：运行成功
Failed：运行失败
Terminating：终止中
Terminated：已终止
Unknown：未知
Skipped：跳过（前序节点失败导致）
ReadyToSchedule：准备运行（前序节点未完成导致）
